title: Integrate #46 and repair metadata/closure regressions
problem: #46's authored suite passes, but independent probes show listings omit tags/tag-derived provenance and premise-free explicit closure persists Concluding atoms that fail the bundled validator.
outcome: All of #46's intended hardening is retained on the reconciled baseline, with both public-contract regressions repaired and permanently tested across the three server bundles.
hard_constraints: Decode tags_json into public metadata without restoring all-graph hydration. Preserve tags, model/orchestrator fallback, column precedence, counts, ordering, project filter and limit behavior.

Without an outcome, session finish remains a lifecycle Observation. With an outcome, a Concluding must cite genuine in-trace Finding/Observation/Evidence support. When no eligible premise exists, reject before any atom, edge, counter or session-binding mutation.
Never fabricate a premise, silently change an outcome, or weaken refer_at_least_one to make tests pass. Keep met/unmet/partially_met explicit and validate invalid combinations.
Preserve SQLite serialization/cycle prevention and atomic IDs, provenance resume backfill, live opt-out, newline/UTF-8 buffering, empty-atom lint rejection, and versioned LSP synchronization.

The review's nine metadata probes remain positive parity tests. The nine premise-free closure probes become explicit rejection/no-mutation tests under the safer contract; add supported-closure export/lint tests. Document this contract change rather than disguising it as a passing old test.

Preserve every j01 migration/provenance/viewer/skills regression, including synthetic populated old-schema migration across all three bundles. Original PR42/43/46 refs are immutable. Reconcile merge conflicts explicitly, no blanket ours/theirs.

All test DBs must be synthetic and disposable; do not inspect/copy an operator database or transcript. Never pip install into the host/runner venv; use your own isolated venv. Shared checkout and other repos are read-only. No broad git add.

Independent acceptance requires the 36-case synthetic probe across all three standalone hosts. Contract and probe live in .ralph/contracts; run each host with python -I -S .ralph/contracts/probe_integrity.py --source <exact-clean-export> --host <codex|claude-code|ollama> --enforce. This is additive to full canonical/adversarial tests, not a replacement.

Provenance/Scholia diagnostic enforcement is report_only. Do not weaken product tests, validator semantics, required fixture counts, auth or correctness gates. Preserve truthful trace evidence even if diagnostic discrepancies occur.

Independent inventory found missing/weak adversarial coverage: explicitly test concurrent atom unique IDs/ordinals, opposite links in all three bundles, UTF-8 chunks split inside a multibyte character, and LSP stale edit keeping exact latest content/ranges (URI-only assertion insufficient). Add tests that fail if those guarantees regress.
